  "displayName" text NOT NULL,

  "grade" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ownerId" text NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT "ChildProfile_grade_rule_ab1ddaff" CHECK ("grade" BETWEEN 1 AND 4)
)
